notes.title: COMING SOON!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33323827/6d346cacc57f25f24d57141fd81583c22f6be233.jpg[/img]

Just a quick note to say that we are currently translating the Character Generator into the following languages –
[list]
[*]English
[*]Simplified Chinese
[*]Korean
[*]Russian
[*]Japanese
[/list]
– and expect to release it [u]in 3-4 weeks[/u] here on Steam. Eventually we may also add German and French, but at the moment we're unsure of the timing for these languages.

Thanks a lot to everyone who already provided feedback about this project on the Discord server, and we really look forward to making the generator available as soon as we can!

–––
